# pi-glance 0.6.7

## Changes

- Show Working activity as a moving highlight on the workspace title and its connecting line. The effect is enabled by default; Git, cost, speed, context, tokens, and model information stay still.
- Add **General → Working animation** in `/glance`. Turn it off to restore Pi's Working indicator. Selecting the setting previews the effect, and saving applies it without replacing the editor or clearing your input.
- Use a broad, feathered highlight with a contrasting core across all 22 palettes, including ANSI 256-color terminals. The display clock targets 30 FPS; the movement speed remains independent of frame rate.
- Pause the animation for blocking dialogs and stop it when the run settles or is cancelled. Retry and compaction notices remain visible.
- Reuse palette, gradient, and glyph data, and avoid per-character work outside the moving highlight. Animation does not trigger Git collection or recalculate session usage.

## Compatibility

- Tested with Pi 0.84.4 and 0.85.1 on Node.js 22.19.0 and 24.
- Config schema is now v9. Missing `editor.workingSweep` defaults to `true`; an explicit `false` is preserved. Existing preferences are retained, and config files are rewritten only when you save settings.
- Bash-mode border colors, status layout, and editor keybindings are unchanged.

## Update

```bash
pi install npm:pi-glance@0.6.7
```

Restart Pi or run `/reload`.
